_doc: See FILTERS.md for hypothesis/evidence/removal-criteria of each entry. Council 2026-05-22: max 3 active filters per bot. Each filter has 'shadow' mode (log only, no enforcement) or 'enforced' mode.

consecutive_loss_cooldown.hypothesis: 3 SL hits within 4h = regime mismatch, pause 6h to wait it out
consecutive_loss_cooldown.removal_when: If any winning bot (Signal 71% WR) hits cooldown >2/week → raise threshold to 4 or scope to losing bots only

live_signal_only.hypothesis: Live $220 can only run validated bots (Signal post-fix WR 71%); others must prove 14d shadow WR > 50% first
live_signal_only.evidence: Signal n=7 post-fix WR 71%, others n=0-18 not validated
live_signal_only.removal_when: Each blocked source ≥30 trades post-fix on demo with WR > 50%

score_threshold.hypothesis: Raising min 6→7 filters bottom-quartile signals that statistically lose
score_threshold.evidence: post-fix WR 71% on n=7 — likely already filtered well; need shadow comparison
score_threshold.removal_when: If 14d shadow: filtered subset WR not ≥ unfiltered + 5pp OR PF < 1.5

atr_floor_sl.hypothesis: SL_BUFFER 0.3% sits INSIDE typical ETH sweep extension; widen to 1.5×ATR to escape stop hunt
atr_floor_sl.evidence: Council critic insight; pre-fix Sweep 0/6 WR with tight SL
atr_floor_sl.removal_when: If WR doesn't improve to >40% on n>=15 by 2026-06-21

tod_filter_asia.hypothesis: Asia low-liq amplifies stop hunts on Sweep entries
tod_filter_asia.removal_when: If 14d shadow: trades in 03-07 UTC don't show negative expectancy on n>=10

single_symbol_eth.hypothesis: BTC/SOL/XRP/LINK previously tested with poor results; ETH-only minimizes risk while learning
single_symbol_eth.evidence: Backtest SOL 48.6% WR -9.19%/90d; BTC 38.3% WR -7.99%; cost kinder -$107 on single bad SL
single_symbol_eth.removal_when: After Sweep ETH proves profitable (WR>50% n>=20), can re-add SOL/BTC selectively

atr_floor_sl.hypothesis: SL 0.2% < BTC 4h ATR 1.5-2.5% → SL inside noise = stop-hunt magnet
atr_floor_sl.evidence: Council #4 critique; 0 trades to date but math says current SL too tight
atr_floor_sl.removal_when: If OB starts firing and WR achievable without ATR floor on n>=20

tod_filter_asia.hypothesis: Same as Sweep — Asia low-liq amplifies false breakouts
tod_filter_asia.evidence: No data yet — OB has 0 trades

score_squared_sizing.hypothesis: Stronger signals deserve bigger size — concentrates capital on high-conviction trades
score_squared_sizing.evidence: Council 2026-05-21 approved; previous cap=1.0 wasted amplification range
score_squared_sizing.removal_when: If score reliability degrades (high-score signals show WR ≤ low-score)

tp_sl_from_actual_fill.hypothesis: Inline TP/SL on pre-order ticker = wrong because of slippage; LastPrice trigger for TP catches actual moves; MarkPrice for SL prevents manipulation
tp_sl_from_actual_fill.evidence: INFLECTION POINT 2026-05-19 21:06 UTC: owner pre-fix -$251/d avg → post-fix +$73/d avg
tp_sl_from_actual_fill.removal_when: NEVER — this is the most validated change in the system
